criteria.note: Installation and quickstart render npm @mifune/agro/get-agro.sh followed by agro sandbox install docker; agro update upgrades the CLI and oh update vendors project files.

criteria.criterion: Required path excludes retired source workflows
criteria.note: Required path has no clone, fork, install.sh, or config repo; retained source workflows are grouped and labeled optional or historical.

criteria.criterion: Canonical fallback and independent shim wording
criteria.note: Rendered fallback is ghcr.io/mifunedev/agro:latest. Retained legacy npm wording says its own manifest pins an exact dependency without claiming release-version parity.

criteria.criterion: Desktop installation and mobile quickstart visual quality
criteria.note: Read-only reviewer observed readable headings, body text, navigation, links, and code styling with no visible error state at 1280x720 and 414x896.
